  "content": "# UI core — HeroUI, forms, shell, feedback

## HeroUI baseline
- Use HeroUI v3 for all new UI work.
- Do not create custom base controls when HeroUI v3 provides an equivalent.
- Always use `UiCheckbox` (`src/shared/ui/HeroFieldControls.tsx`) for booleans; never native `<input type="checkbox">`.
- Use `UiRadioGroup` (`src/shared/ui/HeroFieldControls.tsx`) for radio option lists; do not hand-roll `Radio` / `RadioGroup` rows. Option labels use `HERO_UI_RADIO_LABEL_NUDGE_CLASS` (`translate-y-[2px]`) so text optically aligns with the control; stacked choice lists use `UI_CHOICE_STACK_GAP_CLASS` (`gap-1`); checkbox rows use `resolveUiChoiceLabelRowClass`.
- Custom UI only when HeroUI v3 lacks required behavior.
- Default size `sm` for form field controls (`UiInput`, `UiSelect`, `UiTextarea`, `UiAutocomplete`, `UiCheckbox`, `SemVerInput`, `UrlSegmentSlugInput`, designer field wrappers). **Prefer `sm` and `md`** for routine product UI; **`xs` and `lg` are supported** via `heroFieldSize.ts` when a surface genuinely needs tighter or larger controls — size choice is not hard-limited to two values.
- Avoid overriding HeroUI visual styles; layout classes only.
- `ui_color`: unified color picker + hex input in one field container.

## Semantic color (subtle, small-area)
- Use gentle, concept-matched color to aid scanning — not decoration.
- Prefer color on **text, icons, badges, pills, and other small objects** — not large backgrounds or full-panel fills.
- Large surfaces stay white/neutral (page shell, modal body, grid host).
- Panel identity: light tinted **headers/borders only** (`AppSurfaceBox` tone, dialog bands) — never saturated body washes.
- Reuse existing semantic maps: `buttonSemantics.ts`, `ICON_ACTION_*_CLASS`, `APP_SURFACE_BOX_TONE_CLASS`, grid action colors — no ad-hoc palette entries.
- One or two accent hues per view is enough; avoid rainbow pages.

## Typography hierarchy
- Vary **size, weight, and case** so users spot the topic at first glance.
- Clear ladder: page/section title → subsection label → field label → body/helper.
- Reuse tokens: `DIALOG_PRIMARY_HEADER_TITLE_CLASS`, `APP_SURFACE_BOX_TITLE_CLASS`, `PAGE_HEADER_TITLE_CLASS` / `PAGE_HEADER_META_CLASS` (inline title + description in page toolbars), field labels `text-sm font-semibold`, metadata `text-xs text-slate-500`.
- Section labels: `text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500` (see `CacheSettingsFields.tsx`).
- Wizard/create form sections: use flat `FormSection` + `FormField` — accent bar + typography + `divided` spacing; do **not** wrap ordinary field groups in bordered panel boxes (see `ui-dialog.md` and **Form field layout** below).
- **Settings config forms:** use `SettingsFormGroup` (`SettingsFormPrimitives.tsx`) — thin wrapper over `FormSection` with section tone from `settingsSectionSemantics.ts`; first group plain, subsequent groups `divided`; do **not** use `AppSurfaceBox` for field grouping; grid/CRUD sections (AI Models, MCP, Cultures, …) keep `AppTableGrid` / tree grids as data hosts only.
- **Settings section spacing:** **between** groups use `divided` (`FORM_SECTION_DIVIDED_CLASS`, `pt-3`); **inside** a group stack fields with `SETTINGS_FORM_GROUP_BODY_STACK_CLASS` (`space-y-2`); multi-column rows use `SETTINGS_FORM_GRID_GAP_CLASS` (`gap-2`); label-to-control stays `gap-[2px]` per label-over-input rule; do **not** put `space-y-*` or `gap-*` stack utilities directly on `<fieldset>` — use `SettingsDisabledFieldset` (inner wrapper div) for toggle-disabled blocks; reference `PwaSettingsSection.tsx`.
- **Settings label bands:** `SETTINGS_FIELD_LABEL_BAND_CLASS` (`min-h-8`, `items-end`) aligns labels in **grid columns**; for full-width fields stacked below a grid (e.g. Description, Message textarea) pass `labelBand={false}` on `SettingsField` so the band does not add extra vertical gap.
- **Settings feature toggles:** boolean toggles (`SettingsToggleField` / `UiCheckbox`) must **not** hide dependent fields when off — keep sections visible and disable child controls (`SettingsDisabledFieldset` / `<fieldset disabled>` with `disabled:opacity-60`, or per-control `disabled`); nested toggles also disable when the parent feature is off; do not conditionally unmount field groups on toggle; reference `PwaSettingsSection.tsx`, `IdentityProviderFormModal.tsx`.
- **Settings typography:** ladder via `getSettingsTypography(sectionId)` in `settingsSectionTypography.ts` — page title `text-base font-bold` tinted by section tone; group descriptions, field labels (`text-[11px] font-bold uppercase`), hints (`text-[11px]`), toggles/checkbox cards pick up section accent when active/checked; grid primary/secondary/mono lines reuse the same tone map; log-level options use `LOG_LEVEL_OPTION_TYPOGRAPHY` (DEBUG slate, INFO indigo, WARN amber, ERROR rose); semantic color on text/icons/badges only — not large surface fills.
- **Settings label info (ⓘ):** use `SettingsLabelInfoRow` or `labelInfo` / `titleInfo` on settings primitives — the info icon sits **immediately after** the label text (`inline-flex`, `gap-0.5`); never push the icon with `flex-1` on the label; **reserve a fixed 16×16 icon slot** (`reserveInfoSlot`, default true) when neighbors may omit `labelInfo`; default `labelBand` on **SettingsField** for grid cells — omit the band with `labelBand={false}` on stacked full-width fields; do **not** use that band on `SettingsToggleField` (checkbox row uses `items-center` instead); reuse `SettingsNavScopeHint`.
- Use `font-semibold` / `font-bold` for emphasis only — do not flatten everything to one size and weight.

## English-only copy
- All user-facing strings in application source (`src/`, `scripts/` generators, culture bundles, seeds, eval corpora) must be **English**.
- Do not add Persian, Arabic, or other non-English UI copy in TS/TSX/JSON — even for RTL culture packs (`ir`, `iq`); those packs may keep `direction: rtl` and jalali/hijri calendars but translation values stay English.
- Markdown documentation is exempt.
- Machine standard: `ui.copy.english-only` in `projectStandards.ts`.

## Label over input
- One vertical container for label + control.
- Label start padding: `ps-[4px]`.
- Label-to-control spacing: exactly `2px` (`gap-[2px]`, `mt-[2px]`, or `mb-[2px]`).
- Do not use `gap-1`, `mb-1.5`, `mt-1` for label-to-control spacing.

## Invalid field state
- Pass `isInvalid` (and optional `errorMessage`) on `UiInput`, `UiSelect`, `UiTextarea`, `UiAutocomplete`, `SemVerInput`, and `UrlSegmentSlugInput`.
- In `FormField`, pass `invalid` or `error` — the shell clones the child control and sets `isInvalid` automatically when the child does not already define it.
- **Required fields:** show invalid border from the **initial render** until the value satisfies validation — do not wait for blur, touch, or submit. Mark the label with `required` (rose asterisk) and pass `invalid` from your field validator; use `error` only for meaningful helper text (format mismatch, etc.) — not for empty required state. `FormField` `showError={false}` hides helper text while keeping the invalid border.
- Invalid controls use a **subtle rose border** via `HEROUI_FIELD_INVALID_BORDER_CLASS` (`!border !border-rose-300`); default neutral border is `HEROUI_FIELD_BORDER_CLASS` (`!border-slate-300`) in `surfaceClasses.ts`.
- Composite/segmented fields use `resolveHeroUiFieldBorderClass(isInvalid)` — do not ad-hoc per-page red borders.
- Error helper text: default **`feedbackPlacement="overlay"`** — validation hints render in a tooltip above the control via `FieldFeedbackShell` (`fieldFeedback.tsx`); pass `feedbackPlacement="below"` for legacy under-control text (`text-xs text-rose-600`, `ps-[4px]`, `mt-[2px]`). `FormField` forwards `error` as `errorMessage` and respects the same placement.
- Keep invalid styling on the border only — no heavy red fills or thick outlines.

## Form field layout (product forms)

Canonical reference: **Sandbox → form-fields** (`src/features/sandbox/form-fields/FormFieldsSandboxWorkspace.tsx`). Shared tokens: `heroFieldSize.ts`, `formChoiceLayout.ts`, `HeroFieldControls.tsx` (`UiRadioGroup`, choice row classes).

### Control sizes
- Sizes: `xs` | `sm` (default) | `md` | `lg` — `HERO_UI_FIELD_SIZES` / `resolveHeroUiFieldSizeTokens` in `src/shared/ui/heroFieldSize.ts`.
- **Prefer `sm` and `md`** for routine UI; `xs` / `lg` when a surface needs tighter or larger controls — not hard-limited to two values.
- One active size per form surface in product UI (preview/sandbox may expose a size switcher in the section header toolbar).

### Section grouping (`FormSection` + `FormField`)
- Use flat `FormSection` groups with accent bar, tone, optional `description`, and `divided` on every group after the first (`FORM_SECTION_DIVIDED_CLASS` / `pt-3`).
- Intra-form body stack between groups: `flex flex-col gap-1` (see sandbox preview fields).
- Do **not** wrap ordinary field groups in rounded panel boxes — exception: **boxed multi-choice lists** below.
- Pair related short fields in two columns when both are visible: `resolveFormFieldPairGridClass(true)` → `grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-x-4 sm:items-stretch`; single column when only one field shows.
- Full-width fields (textarea, long notes) below pair grids — not inside the two-column grid.
- Composite / specialty controls (`SemVerInput`, `UrlSegmentSlugInput`) may share the same pair grid pattern as text/select.

### Label-over-input fields
- One vertical container per field (`FormField` or `AiAssistFormField`); label `ps-[4px]`; **2px** gap to control (`gap-[2px]`).
- Pass `size` on every control; `required` + `invalid` on `FormField` for required-empty-on-mount (see invalid field state above).
- Default `feedbackPlacement="overlay"`; `below` only when explicitly needed.

### EUA-assisted fields (`AiAssistFormField`)
- Use for single-line and multiline text eligible for context suggest / field assist.
